verses.1: David trusted in the Lord, and He became his protector; because he trusted in Him, He delivered him from the hand of King Saul.
verses.2: And at the time of Absalom his son, and at the time of the Philistines, and at the time of the Amalekites and the Edomites, and at the time of the hornets, and from all these who rose up against him, the Lord delivered David, because he trusted in Him and kept His law.
verses.3: But as for those kings who did not trust in Him, the wicked ones, the Lord did not deliver them, because they were defeated by the hand of their enemies; for defeat comes from the Lord.
verses.4: Hezekiah trusted in the Lord, and He delivered him from the hand of the mighty Syrian.
verses.5: But Manasseh his son was defeated by the hand of his enemy, because he did not set his trust upon the Lord. And moreover, those enemies who defeated Manasseh were not like him; rather, they took him captive and carried him away to their land, because he did not set his trust upon the Lord, and did not fear Him who had honored him, exalted him, and magnified him.
verses.6: And again, He withheld from him the gift which He had given him, because he did not direct his way toward the Lord his God, that He might prolong his days, and that his enemy might not rise up against him, and that he might have strength, power, and abundance.
verses.7: For it is not by a multitude of hosts that one prevails, but by trusting in the Lord, and not by trusting in horses, javelins, and bows.
verses.8: For he who trusts in the Lord shall live, and be honored, and be greatly exalted.
verses.9: But those who did not trust in the Lord, but trusted in the abundance of their possessions, were deprived of His grace which He had given them; for the Lord does not regard the face.
verses.10: And those who trust in Him, He guards them; and those who enslave others, He enslaves them; and He does not withhold His help from them in their affliction, when their enemies rise up against them, because they have fixed their heart upon His covenant with the Lord, and have kept the commandments of the Lord.
verses.11: And he who has fixed his heart upon the covenant of the Lord and upon the covenant of His commandments, and has kept His law—He will indeed be a protector to him in his affliction.
verses.12: And He makes him rejoice in the wall of his enemy, and in the spoil of the cattle of his adversaries, and in the plunder of the land of his enemy, and in the rain of its seasons, and in the fruit of its crops, and in the increase of its produce, and in the fruit of the trees of its gardens.
verses.13: And with righteousness and justice, and with grass and blossom, and with His blessings, so that Your people who are under Your hand may rejoice.
verses.14: And they shall eat the bread of strangers, and shall gather the gleanings of their enemies, and cattle, and herds, and flocks; and they shall eat the bread of strangers, and shall carry off the plunder of the sons of their enemies.
verses.15: This the Lord does for him who loves Him; but for him who hates Him, He appoints destruction for his enemy.
verses.16: And He binds his hands and his feet, and delivers him into the hand of his enemy, and appoints a scourge for his adversaries; and he shall not rejoice in the seed of his house, because he became a transgressor of the commandment of the Lord and a shedder of blood.
verses.17: And he shall not stand in judgment, and He requites them the fruit of their deeds, for those who do evil, for the evildoers, when He repays evil.
verses.18: But for the doers of good, that He may repay them with good, He commanded them from the Lord by His own hand, that He might keep them.
verses.19: And He also commanded them to keep the commandment, for He sent him over all that He created, that he might do good, and that He might give them eternal life, and that they might glorify the Lord who created them; and there is none who transgresses His commandment, from Him who created them, except man alone.
verses.20: And all of them obey Him and are kept by His commandment and by His ordinance, as the Lord of the earth commanded them, for all who dwell according to His ordinance.
verses.21: But man transgresses against Him who made him king over all the beasts and cattle, and over all the birds which the Lord created.
verses.22: Whether those in the sea, or those on the dry land, and all that the Lord created, He subjected to our father Adam, that he might do what He willed, and eat of them like the grass of the earth, and rule over them and subdue them, whether beasts or cattle; and the Lord God gave them to him, that they might be subject to man. And as for man, He made him king, that he might be subject to the Lord, because of the glory He had given him; and He appointed him over all that He created, that they might serve him and be subject to him.
verses.23: But if they transgress His commandment, He also takes away from them the gift which He gave them, and He repays him who does His will; for He is the King of heaven and earth.
verses.24: And whom He wills, He appoints; and whom He wills, He removes; and He kills and gives life; He is angry and He is gracious.
verses.25: And there is no other like Him, and there is none who can restrain Him; for He is Lord of all that He created, and there is no other God besides Him, in heaven above and on earth below.
verses.26: And He appoints and removes, and kills and gives life, and is angry and is gracious, and humbles and exalts.
verses.27: And He draws near to those who ask Him, and to him who does His will with a pure heart; He also hears their prayer, and does their will in all that they ask of Him.
verses.28: And He commands them, small and great, and all that belongs to them that is in the mountains and hills, and the cisterns and the depths, and the ends of the earth, and the sea and the dry land.
verses.29: And all that is theirs belongs to those who do the will of their God; and He does not withhold from them His blessing, and He gives them the reward of their praises.
verses.30: And in heaven He will give them the glory which He prepared for their fathers, for Abraham, and for Isaac, and for Jacob, and for David, and for Hezekiah, and for Samuel, who did not transgress His commandment nor His ordinance, for the Lord.
verses.31: That He may give them the inheritance which He swore to their fathers, to Abraham, and to Isaac, and to Jacob, whom He chose from of old, and that they may rejoice in His kingdom.
